about_the_game:
Uncover even darker truths in the Halloween Secrets: The Blood Vow – DLC! Step beyond the castle walls into four new chilling locations, each brimming with hidden objects, eerie puzzles, and haunting mini-games. Among cursed relics, forgotten books, and sinister diaries, shadows whisper of witches who refused to fade into legend. Every clue you find draws you deeper into Darkhand’s cursed history, where nightmares bleed into reality and secrets refuse to stay buried. Dare to explore these new mysteries and face what the witches left behind!

With every hidden object found and every puzzle solved, you edge closer to uncovering the blood vow that bound the sisters to the castle. But beware—some secrets were meant to stay hidden, and the price of discovery may be higher than you think.

🎃 The Forgotten Study

Search the locked study where a mysterious painting reveals the witches’ faces, long believed erased from history. Hidden objects and puzzles await inside, along with an artifact that holds the truth of the sisters’ fate.

🎃 The Abandoned Lecture Hall

Step into the dust-covered lecture hall, where ancient tomes whisper secrets of Darkhand and forbidden rituals. Solve cryptic mini-games and uncover rare clues before time runs out—these books may hold the key to breaking the curse.

🎃 The Toy Store of Shadows

Explore the eerie toy shop stand said to house relics from Darkhand Castle. Every corner hides sinister objects and tricky puzzles. Complete challenges, examine magical curiosities, and claim the long-lost witches’ advertising sign.

🎃 Amalia’s Well and the Diary

Follow the witches’ book to Amalia’s well and reveal a secret passage. Break the cauldron’s dark bond by deciphering the sisters’ diary. Hidden objects and layered puzzles guard the clues that could sever the soul’s cursed tether.

Step into the shadows, uncover the forgotten, and test your courage—because in Darkhand Castle, the real horror begins where the story once ended.
